integrity: The defining 2026 source, its publication date, MSC classification, and scientific scope were checked directly. The exact order is reconstructed from the real-part formula for tanh, an analytic reduction of the disk extremum to one boundary arc, a reproducible global derivative-sign certificate, and the canonical Ma–Minda extremal. Earlier full-tanh radius and coefficient papers were compared for implication coverage.
scientific_limitations: The finding determines the sharp classical order of starlikeness for the half-tanh Ma–Minda class. It does not determine a sharp sectorial/strong-starlikeness order or improve the coefficient-functional results of the defining paper. The critical constant is characterized as the unique root of an explicit transcendental equation rather than an elementary closed form.
title: Sharp starlikeness order for the half-tanh Ma–Minda class
